Hero.headline: Tsinda ikizamini cy'uruhushya rw'agateganyo witonze
Hero.subheadline: Witoze mu buryo bw'igihe nyacyo, nk'uko bigenda mu kizamini nyakuri, ku mategeko yose y'umuhanda y'u Rwanda. Ikizamini cyawe cya mbere ni ubuntu rwose.

HowItWorks.title: Uko bikorwa
HowItWorks.subtitle: Intambwe enye zoroshye, guhera wiyandikisha kugeza ku manota yawe ya mbere yo kwitoza.

step1.title: Iyandikishe
step1.description: Fungura konti yawe mu munota umwe gusa ukoresheje numero ya telefone yawe.

step2.title: Hitamo
step2.description: Hitamo icyiciro runaka wifuza kwitoza cyane, cyangwa ukore ikizamini cyuzuye.

step3.title: Witoze
step3.description: Subiza mu gihe ntarengwa — nk’uko bigenda ku munsi w’ikizamini.

step4.title: Suzuma
step4.description: Menya amanota yawe ako kanya, hamwe n'ibisobanuro kuri buri kibazo.

Categories.subtitle: Ibyiciro bitanu birimo ibibazo byose byerekeye uruhushya rw'agateganyo.

cat1.name: Ibyapa n'ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda
cat1.description: Kumenya no gusobanukirwa ibyapa, imirongo, n'ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda.

cat2.name: Uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere
cat2.description: Kumenya uwakagombye gutambuka mbere ku masangano, ku nzibacyuho, nahari ibinyabiziga by'ubutabazi.

cat3.name: Kunyuranaho no guhindura icyerekezo
cat3.description: Kunyuranaho, guhindura umurongo, guhindukira, guhagarara, no guparika.

cat4.name: Umuvuduko ntarengwa n'ibipimo by'ibinyabiziga
cat4.description: Umuvuduko ntarengwa n'amategeko y'ibipimo n'uburemere nk'uko amategeko y'u Rwanda abiteganya.

cat5.name: Amategeko rusange y'umuhanda
cat5.description: Ibibazo 400+ birimo amategeko yose y'agateganyo agenga umuhanda.

Faq.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
Faq.subtitle: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa ku biciro, ibizamini, n'uko kwitoza bikorwa.

q1.question: Ikiguzi ni angahe?
q1.answer: Ikizamini cyawe cya mbere cyo kwitoza ni ubuntu rwose. Nyuma, ongeramo amafaranga muri konti yawe ukomeze ku giciro gito kuri buri kizamini.

q2.question: Bigenda gute iyo ntsinzwe?
q2.answer: Nta n'imwe ku bwinshi bw'ibizamini wemerewe kwitoza — ongeramo amafaranga wongere ugerageze incuro nyinshi uko ushaka, kugeza ubona witeguye.

q3.question: Nshobora gusuzuma amakosa yanjye?
q3.answer: Yego. Igihe ikizamini kirangiye, uzabona amanota yawe hamwe n'ibisobanuro kuri buri kibazo, harimo n'ibyo wasubijeho nabi.

q4.question: Ni izihe ndimi zikoreshwa?
q4.answer: Iyi urubuga iboneka mu Cyongereza, Ikinyarwanda, n'Igifaransa. Ibibazo by'ikizamini ubwabyo kugeza ubu biri mu Kinyarwanda gusa.
